title: AI slop
body: From first it looked amazing, but It just took my money straight, even thought I wanted to try some trial. There is none I guess. Wrote to support - nothing. App is very clunky and I try tried guided meditation, it just stopped suddenly because the screen on phone turned off. Also there is this AI voice telling you what to do “ breath twice at your own pace” but it doesnt wait for you, it just keeps going on, it ruins the whole session basicaly. Also I was expecting the app to challenge me, but it doesnt feel like it.
author: MaDmonkeey
